## Workflow Commands

```bash
# Rebuild MathJax macro include
python3 scripts/generate_math_macros.py \
  sty_files/PresentationShortcuts.sty \
  --output presentations/styles/presentation-macros.html

# Regenerate standalone tikz assets
scripts/regenerate_asset_svgs.sh assets/tikz

# Preview one section from showcase edit deck
scripts/presentation_edit_preview.sh presentations/showcase code --no-browser --port 4305
```

::: {.code-note .fragment}
Use `presentation.edit.qmd` for focused iteration and keep `presentation.qmd` as canonical deck assembly.
:::

## Executable Code (Python)

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| cache: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 300)
y = np.sin(x) * np.exp(-0.06 * x)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(x, y, linewidth=3, color="#2C7FB8")
ax.set_title("Damped Sine Wave")
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("y")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```

::: {.meta}
This follows the Quarto Reveal executable-code pattern: Python runs during render and output is embedded in the slide.
:::
